newsitem.title: CHINA: CHIWAN PETROLEUM H1 NET DOWN 11 PCT.
newsitem.headline: CHIWAN PETROLEUM H1 NET DOWN 11 PCT.

text.p: Half year ended June 30, 1997 (in millions of yuan unless otherwise stated, against first-half 1996 figures):
Earnings per share 0.10 yuan vs 0.12 yuan
Net assets per share 2.15 yuan vs 2.10 yuan
Company name: Shenzhen Chiwan Petroleum Supply Base Co Ltd.
NOTE: The unaudited results, calculated under international accounting standards, were published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Friday.
Trading in the company's B shares was suspended on Friday morning pending the announcement and would resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said.
The company specialises in the provision of logistical services for foreign firms that explore for oil in the South China Sea.
